content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on setting up a basic timer circuit. I want it so that when an input signal turns on, a delay timer activates for a set period, then turns on an output. When the input turns off, the output goes off and a lockout timer begins to prevent the output from being reactivated for a set time. The setup seems straightforward, but I haven't been able to get it functioning correctly. Any guidance would be appreciated!
